headword: {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}

definitions.explanation: Light exercises performed before physical activity to prepare the body, prevent injury, and improve performance. A standard part of physical education and sports in Japan.

examples.japanese: ⟦{泳|およ}ぐ→泳ぐ：00545_oyogu⟧⟦{前|まえ}→前：02255_mae⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しよう→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: Let's do warm-up exercises before swimming.

examples.japanese: {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦しないで→する：00392_suru⟧⟦{走|はし}ったら→走る：00519_hashiru⟧、⟦{足|あし}→足：00575_ashi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧つってしまった。
examples.english: I got a leg cramp because I ran without warming up.

examples.japanese: ⟦{体育|たいいく}→体育：03384_taiiku⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{授業|じゅぎょう}→授業：00781_jugyou⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、⟦まず→まず：00796_mazu⟧⟦{全員|ぜんいん}→全員：03310_zenin⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦して→する：00392_suru⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧⟦{運動|うんどう}→運動：00821_undou⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{始|はじ}める。
examples.english: In PE class, everyone does warm-up exercises together before starting the activity.

notes:
USAGE:
A fundamental concept in Japanese physical education. In schools, students typically perform {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう} at the beginning of every PE class. Many workplaces also do ⟦{朝|あさ}→朝：02277_asa⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧ (morning exercises), such as ⟦ラジオ→ラジオ：01541_rajio⟧⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧.

FORMS:
⟦{準備|じゅんび}→準備：01431_junbi⟧ (preparation) + ⟦{体操|たいそう}→体操：04493_taisou⟧ (physical exercises, gymnastics).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (to do warm-up exercises)
- {準備体操|じゅんびたいそう}⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{始|はじ}める (to start with warm-ups)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦ウォーミングアップ→ウォーミングアップ：27675_woominguappu⟧: warming up — loanword, used in sports contexts
- ⟦ストレッチ→ストレッチ：05239_sutorecchi⟧: stretching — focuses specifically on stretching muscles
- {整理体操|せいりたいそう}: cool-down exercises — done after exercise to help the body recover
